newsitem.title: JAPAN: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 14.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Top Japan business news - Nov 14.

text.p: The Japanese government's administrative reform committee will propose that the government introduce numerical criteria to monitor the efficiency of public services such as the postal system and the treasury investment and loans system.
The French and Italian governments will offer shares in their state-run telephone companies in markets in Europe, Japan and other parts of Asia next year.
West Japan Railway Co (JR West) plans to cut its workforce by about 25 percent, or 13,000 employees, over the next 10 years.
